title: The housing market in Amsterdam, 1550-1850
authors: Dr C.M. Lesger, Universiteit van Amsterdam, Afdeling Geschiedenis
descriptions: This dataset has been created for research on the historical development of the costs of renting houses in Amsterdam, from 1550 until 1850. The first file gives rent index figures and the second file lists the houses and rent extracted from sources.
